description.en: Adds the official agent skill for the open-source Mole CLI (`mo`) on macOS and Windows: read disk usage, preview and run cleanup, inspect installed apps, and read system health and cleanup history from Mole's JSON output. The skill previews with --dry-run and asks before removing anything, and leaves app uninstalls and privileged steps to the user's own terminal. The plugin ships only the skill; the CLI is installed separately. GPL-3.0.
description.zh: 为 macOS 和 Windows 上的开源 Mole CLI（`mo`）加上官方 skill：按 Mole 的 JSON 输出查看磁盘占用、预览并执行清理、查看已安装应用、读取系统健康状态和清理记录。清理前先用 --dry-run 预览并征得同意，卸载应用和需要管理员权限的步骤留给用户在自己的终端里执行。插件只带 skill，CLI 需另外安装。GPL-3.0。
